s.en: tool for linking against MIT Kerberos libraries

o.en: prints a usage message. This is the default behavior when no options are specified.
prints the version, vendor, prefix, and exec-prefix.
prints the version number of the Kerberos installation.
prints the name of the vendor of the Kerberos installation.
prints the prefix for which the Kerberos installation was built.
prints the prefix for executables for which the Kerberos installation was built.
prints the built-in default credentials cache location.
prints the built-in default keytab location.
prints the built-in default client (initiator) keytab location.
prints the compilation flags used to build the Kerberos installation.

prints the compiler options needed to link against library.
